subject: Horizon Labs — Marketplace Buyflow Sync & PO Path
messages:
From: Evan Morales <evan.morales@horizon-labs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: marketplace private offers (Azure + GCP) & PO timeline

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Horizon's legal and finance teams want a concise mutual action plan so we can close a private offer on both Azure and GCP. Key points:
- We expect a 2‑week technical acceptance window (PoC finished last week).
- Procurement needs a clear billing path: Azure wants a private offer acceptance + invoice routing; GCP expects marketplace invoicing or committed spend.
- Finance needs an invoice sample and T&C summary for internal approvals.
- Target close: by end of May if possible (we have a board purchase window the week of May 31).

I've attached the eval logs and the draft SOW (Horizon_eval_results.zip, SOW_Horizon_Integration.docx). Can Redwood provide a short MAP with milestones, owners, and the exact docs procurement needs? Also please confirm any legal redlines that typically block marketplace PO acceptance.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Morales
Head of Platform Ops | Horizon Labs
E: evan.morales@horizon-labs.com
T: +1-415-555-0182
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan.morales@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: marketplace private offers (Azure + GCP) & PO timeline

Evan — appreciate the clarity. We'll put a short MAP together today. High level plan I'm proposing:

1) Immediate (today–May 20): Redwood provides invoice sample, marketplace acceptance checklist for Azure & GCP, and a one‑page legal redline summary. Owner: Priya.
2) Technical acceptance (May 20–May 24): Karthik to validate acceptance criteria and signoff doc. Owner: Karthik.
3) Procurement submission (May 24–May 26): Horizon to submit PO/DocuSign; Redwood to confirm private offer codes and billing routing. Owner: Naomi.
4) Finance & billing handoff (May 26–May 31): Confirm invoice path and archival requirements. Owner: Redwood Finance + Horizon Finance.

I'll loop legal if we hit a redline. Naomi — can you confirm pricing and the private offer codes we will provide for Azure and GCP? Karthik — can you write a 1‑page tech acceptance checklist for Horizon's SREs? Evan — if the board window is May 31, we'll prioritize the procurement steps.

I'll attach the MAP once we have Naomi's price/code confirmation.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morales <evan.morales@horizon-labs.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: marketplace private offers (Azure + GCP) & PO timeline

On Wed, May 18, 2027 at 11:04 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Evan — appreciate the clarity. We'll put a short MAP together today.

Quick technical acceptance checklist (draft):
- Core inference latency within agreed thresholds for 8k token average workload (test harness attached in eval zip).
- KV cache warmup and cold-start measurement: 95th percentile within SLA for burst traffic.
- Model variant parity: provided quantized LLM must match sample prompts in eval (see eval_results).
- API authentication: validate OIDC SSO + marketplace entitlement token exchange flows.
- Sample runbook: steps to switch to fallback model if capacity constraints occur.

I'll convert to a one‑page signoff and drop into the MAP. If Horizon's SREs have specific test harness access needs (IP allowlist / temporary keys), let me know.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morales <evan.morales@horizon-labs.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & private offer codes

Priya / team — per internal pricing approval:
- Deal ID: DEAL-2027-0893
- Committed monthly spend: $45,000 (12‑month term) — applies to both Azure private offer and GCP committed SKU mapping.
- Azure private offer code: AZ-PO-7892 (will be sent to Horizon procurement portal once doc signed).
- GCP marketplace mapping: GCP-PRIV-4561 (Redwood will confirm invoice routing; default is marketplace invoicing, but we can enable direct invoice on request).

Olga — please attach the short legal redline memo (we have one standard addendum: Data Processing Addendum + Marketplace Addendum). Evan — procurement typically needs only the addendum + invoice sample to approve.

Naomi
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan.morales@horizon-labs.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Legal redlines & required procurement docs

Evan — attaching the Marketplace Addendum and a 1‑page redline summary. Key notes:
- No unusual data residency requirements in Horizon's SOW; standard DPA applies.
- Payment terms: 30 days net preferred; for marketplace invoices we'll accept standard marketplace terms (these differ by cloud provider).
- Liability caps: standard Redwood limits; if Horizon needs a higher cap, we can escalate to Legal for review (that will add time).

Attachments: Marketplace_Addendum_v2.pdf (stub), Legal_Redline_Summary_Horizon.pdf (stub).

If procurement needs a fully executed DocuSign or an offline PO (PDF), note which path you prefer so Naomi can configure the private offer accordingly.

—Olga
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@horizon-labs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Team — quick update from procurement/finance:
- We are ready to submit the PO today. Attached is the signed Horizon_PO_20270526.pdf.
- Preferred billing: Azure private offer accepted via portal (please send code AZ-PO-7892); for GCP we prefer marketplace invoicing mapped to GCP-PRIV-4561 (Redwood to issue an invoice sample).
- DocuSign link for the SOW would be helpful; otherwise we'll attach the signed PO in our ERM.

Thanks to everyone for the quick turnaround. If we receive the AZ code and an invoice sample by EOD, finance will route the payment on the next cycle.

Regards,
Sarah Kim
Procurement Manager | Horizon Labs
